web_bot_auth.purpose: Retrieves individual scholarly sources that a human-directed research agent has chosen to cite, so that the citation can be checked against the source text rather than asserted. One document at a time, on demand, for a named claim.
web_bot_auth.rate-expectation: Tens of requests per session. Per-host pacing is enforced in the client and shared across every process on a machine; robots.txt Crawl-delay overrides the client's own floor whenever it asks for more room.
web_bot_auth.rate-control: Honours robots.txt (Disallow and Crawl-delay), obeys Retry-After on 429, and raises a host's floor permanently after any refusal for rate. Never solves a proof-of-work or CAPTCHA challenge; where a host gates automated clients the tool records the refusal and looks for a route the host itself publishes.
